rule.name: stable_lane_permutation_candidate_cache
rule.equivalence_key: sort the padded tuple of original option indices ascending with None last
rule.paid_budget: all-idle and one homogeneous seed per option, then the first logical search occurrence of each previously unseen equivalence key
rule.free_reuse: reuse feasibility, service, numerator, duration, and score for later lane permutations; still expand the original logical prefix
rule.post_budget_drain: after K paid attempts, process consecutive frontier cache hits until the next cache miss or exact termination
rule.raw_witness: apply each encountered ordered tuple to the unchanged v4 score-duration-raw-index tie break
rule.unchanged: homogeneous seed order, queue-dependent local order, logical prefix tree, feasibility, support objective, suffix bound, and strict bound pruning

protocol.stopping_rule: run this one fixed quotient-cache rule once on the registered 5,003 states; advance only if every pointwise and population gate passes; if only certificate or attempt work improves without support, raw-lane, or physical-action change, stop as efficiency-only; otherwise close without tuning K, order, bound, or roster

limitations: The registered states and mechanism rationale use consumed development evidence; this is not independent confirmation.
K55 certifies maximum one-frame support only and does not predict mean flow or P90 under policy feedback.
A changed raw lane witness can pair FIFO jobs with completion offsets differently even when its option multiset is unchanged, so trajectory P90 remains unresolved.
The quotient applies to the current identical, fully renewed lanes; heterogeneous persistent lanes would not share this symmetry.
Legacy visited time weights counterfactual fixed-state outcomes and is not variant trajectory time.
